I found two password reset emails from TechServices. I'd use the first one.

**Link from the official sender (support@techservices.com, May 19, 2024, 23:50):**
https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

**Caution about the second email:** A message from tech-services-password@aol.com (May 19, 2024, 23:55) also offers a reset link. It includes a different link (https://www.password-reset-12bh12.com) that doesn't belong to techservices.com, and its techservices.com link has a different token. A free AOL address is not what a company like TechServices would normally use, so this email may be a phishing attempt. I'd avoid clicking anything in it. If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore both emails, and you may want to check your account security.
